mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances when FEDFUNDS increases by more than 0.5% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in real estate sales (HOUST) indicates a strong demand in the economy, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances when HOUST shows a sustained 3-month increase.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% within a month signals economic weakness, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances when UNRATE increases by more than 0.5% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% within a month signals a supply shock, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances when INDPRO decreases by more than 1% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) grow faster than GDP (GDPC1) over a quarter, it signals strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS growth > GDPC1 growth in 1 quarter
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when RSAFS grows faster than GDPC1 over a quarter.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above the inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) for two consecutive months, it indicates a real interest rate environment that is unfavorable for equities, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances when FEDFUNDS is above CPIAUCSL for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates a strong labor market, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when PAYEMS shows a sustained 3-month increase.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year change in consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3%, it signals high inflationary pressure, which erodes consumer purchasing power and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances when CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 3%.
